AlphaFit.description: BR1 fit, `sizing_stats.spanning_alpha`: r = a + b * r_b + e; t by Newey-West lag; t_min gates.
AlphaFit.title: AlphaFit

Analytics.description: The tear sheet (EQ, DD, RET, RR, MRET) for one run or hypothesis.
Analytics.title: Analytics

AnchorComparison.description:
An anchor run against its base: exact equality on trades, P&L, fees and Sharpe (rule 3).

NOT COMPARABLE when the base is missing, either run is unusable (no Sharpe, rule 4) or a count is absent:
a value missing on both sides is never a match.
AnchorComparison.title: AnchorComparison

CompareStats.description:
Headline numbers for a compare view, descriptive, on Basis B. Sharpe and max drawdown come from the tear
sheet's own series (one row per gated session, `analytics.series.run_returns`), so the RUNS table and the
tear sheet show one value; `stats_note` says why they are null (an unusable run, an account whose equity
reached zero, gated sessions that cannot be known).
CompareStats.title: CompareStats

Confirmation.description: A sealed-window confirmatory test: its own alpha, outside the exploratory family.

parent.description: the in-sample hypothesis this confirmation tested
parent.title: Parent

Confirmation.title: Confirmation

freq.description: D: the series as built; M: runs only, sessions compounded into months
freq.title: Freq

CostSensitivity.description: EX4: net P&L against ticks of slippage per contract side, fills held fixed (linear), with break-even.
CostSensitivity.title: CostSensitivity

CostWaterfall.description: EX3: gross, commissions, modelled slippage and net; net equals the run's `pnl_total` exactly.
CostWaterfall.title: CostWaterfall

DesExtract.description: Blocks (RL5) and cost ladder (EX4) read from the screen JSON at fixed paths; never recomputed.
DesExtract.title: DesExtract

DrawdownRow.description: DD2: one episode; `peak` is null when the peak is the starting value, `recovery` null while it is open.
DrawdownRow.title: DrawdownRow

DrawdownView.description: DD1: underwater series of the strategy and the benchmark, and their deepest points.
DrawdownView.title: DrawdownView

EntryGroups.description: TA3: mean net P&L per trade by entry hour (New York time), weekday or month, with its 95% t interval.
EntryGroups.title: EntryGroups

EquitySeries.description:
Basis B equity (ANALYTICS_CATALOG C1): MTM snapshots, or realised P&L on every session of the run.

`t` is integer epoch seconds (snapshot time, or the NYSE close of the session); `pnl` is equity minus the
starting balance. An unusable run (balance check failed, rule 4) has empty arrays, so it cannot be drawn.
`unit` is the account currency of `equity`, `pnl`, `balance` and `unrealized`: USD for every run.
EquitySeries.title: EquitySeries

EquityView.description: EQ: equity after each session, the benchmark on the same axis (null where it has no value).
EquityView.title: EquityView

ExposureSummary.description: `paper_plumbing.exposure_summary` of the book journal: plumbing rows excluded and counted.
ExposureSummary.title: ExposureSummary

ExposureView.description:
EX1: gross and net notional over equity per session, per instrument held, priced at `price_basis` (the raw
contract close; a back-adjusted snapshot price only where no raw close exists, and then labelled so).
ExposureView.title: ExposureView

GateInfo.description: How the prices were served: always caller `terminal` through the OOS gate.
GateInfo.title: GateInfo

HistogramView.description:
RD1: Freedman-Diaconis bins (Sturges when the interquartile range is 0; `bin_rule` names the rule), the
fitted normal as expected counts, and the VaR lines.
HistogramView.title: HistogramView

HomePanel.description:
HOME [B]: equity against the benchmark, with the underwater curve and the rolling Sharpe over the long
window (252 sessions, or 36 months for a monthly series).
HomePanel.title: HomePanel

headline_basis.description: Basis A: a screen value, never an account value
headline_basis.title: Headline Basis

headline_display.description: what the headline value is, for a KPI tile
headline_display.title: Headline Display

headline_label.description: dotted path of the headline value in the screen JSON
headline_label.title: Headline Label

sealed.description: sealed files (by name, as /api/sealed/{name}) that belong to it
sealed.title: Sealed

HypothesisSeries.description: Basis A (ANALYTICS_CATALOG C1): the recorded values in `unit`, and their arithmetic running sum.
HypothesisSeries.title: HypothesisSeries

note.description: why the value is null, or where a stored value was read
note.title: Note

LastClose.description:
The book journal's latest performance close row (plumbing rows dropped, LV1).

The typed fields are read as in `Performance`: `expected` and `actual` are the total contracts held across the
position maps, numbers are finite or null, and a field of an odd type is null. A close that failed its
reconciliation records only `date`, `contract`, `error` and `halted`. `data` is the whole row, sanitised (NaN to
null), for the fields the card does not type (fills, prices by contract, sizing inputs).
LastClose.title: LastClose

LedgerCommand.description: The copy-only `ledger_append` command for an eligible run; the terminal never runs it.
LedgerCommand.title: LedgerCommand

LedgerRow.description: One `results/ledger.csv` row, typed, joined to its run folder (read only; rule 2).
LedgerRow.title: LedgerRow

halted.description: the book journal's latest performance close row; per-journal flags are in journals[].last_halted
halted.title: Halted

LogFileInfo.description: One Nautilus log under live/logs: the `file` value `/api/live/log` accepts.
LogFileInfo.title: LogFileInfo

Moments.description: Per-period Sharpe (ddof 1), population skewness and raw kurtosis (normal 3), as fed to PSR and MinTRL.
Moments.title: Moments

MonthlyView.description: RD2: one row per year, columns January to December (null where a month has no session).
MonthlyView.title: MonthlyView

OosLog.description:
`total`, `key_sets`, `counts_by_caller`, `terminal_reads` and `sealed_reads` describe the whole log;
`matched` counts the entries the filters keep; `entries` is one page of them (see `offset`), oldest first.
OosLog.title: OosLog

Openings.description: The openings file and the gate's own pin checks (True, False, or None when a file cannot be read).
Openings.title: Openings

PairCorrelationSeries.description: Rolling Pearson correlation of two symbols' daily returns (the universe convention), to 2021-12-31.
PairCorrelationSeries.title: PairCorrelationSeries

PassCheck.description: One entry of a screen's `pass_checks`: `passed` for a boolean, else the recorded value.
PassCheck.title: PassCheck

Performance.description: Target against actual over the book journal's performance rows only (plumbing rows dropped, LV1, LV2).
Performance.title: Performance

at_benchmark_note.description: what PSR at the benchmark does and does not test
at_benchmark_note.title: At Benchmark Note

QaReport.description:
A QA or repair report with every market time, year key and epoch after the fence removed (fenced_out
counts them); process write times (`*_utc`) are kept.
QaReport.title: QaReport

QqView.description: RD3: `scipy.stats.probplot` against the normal: ordered returns against theoretical quantiles.
QqView.title: QqView

RegistryCounts.description: Counted from the file at request time (PRD DL12); never a constant.
RegistryCounts.title: RegistryCounts

RegistryEntry.description: SV4 for one hypothesis: the stored registry columns and the terminal's recomputation over the family.
RegistryEntry.title: RegistryEntry

RelativeView.description: BR1 and BR2 against the spec benchmark (C6), computed by the terminal on the aligned rows.
RelativeView.title: RelativeView

RiskView.description: RK1 (1 period, positive numbers are losses) and RK2 (daily series only; null for a monthly book).
RiskView.title: RiskView

RollingView.description:
RL1 and RL2 over a short and a long window (`windows`, in `window_unit`): 63 and 252 sessions for a daily
series, 12 and 36 months for a monthly one (P = 12).
RollingView.title: RollingView

RunComparison.description:
Equity of several runs on one date axis, each divided by its starting balance K (C1), with 1.0 on the day
before its first session; None where a run has no point. The last point is 1 + total_return.
RunComparison.title: RunComparison

RunDetail.description: Everything in result.json except the large arrays (trades, fills, strategy_log lists).
RunDetail.title: RunDetail

RunExposure.description: EX1 and EX2 for one run; `available` is false (with `note`) for a run without snapshots.
RunExposure.title: RunExposure

RunSummary.description: One row of `RUNS`. `readable` is False (and `error` set) when result.json could not be decoded.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunTrades.description: TA1, TA3 and TA6 for one run. `by_hour` is null for a book that enters at the session close by rule.
RunTrades.title: RunTrades

SealedStatus.description:
True or False from the gate's own pin checks; None when a file cannot be read or parsed.

A missing log is not None: the gate counts it as zero sealed lines, which fails the pin (False).
SealedStatus.title: SealedStatus

SealedView.description: One sealed file: JSON without price keys, CSV columns from the allowlist only, or the markdown.
SealedView.title: SealedView

SessionFlags.description:
Sessions `qa.day_gate` rejected (`[GATED]`) and sessions rebuilt from trades (`[REPAIRED]`) in the window,
as session dates; `assessed` is False for a symbol with no session QA.
SessionFlags.title: SessionFlags

SharpeInterval.description: PF4: annualised Sharpe with the Mertens (2002) 95% interval.
SharpeInterval.title: SharpeInterval

SlippageGroup.description:
One TA6 distribution: ticks of 0.25 points, positive = adverse; `matches_stored` against the quote check's
own summary (null for the live rows, which have none).
SlippageGroup.title: SlippageGroup

SlippageView.description:
TA6: real fills only (a 96-trade quote check of za_v0 NQ trades, and the paper book's close rows); the
run's own backtest fills are modelled and get no slippage distribution.

live_plumbing_rows_skipped.description: plumbing rows dropped from the live rows (LV1)
live_plumbing_rows_skipped.title: Live Plumbing Rows Skipped

SlippageView.title: SlippageView

SpecHash.description: One spec re-hashed now (`actual_sha256`) against the hash its result recorded (`recorded_sha256`).
SpecHash.title: SpecHash

StatsTable.description: PF10. Day values are null for a monthly book; month values are its rows.
StatsTable.title: StatsTable

StoredAlpha.description: BR1 read from the screen JSON at a fixed path (`services/stored_alpha.py`), never recomputed.
StoredAlpha.title: StoredAlpha

StoredTradeSummary.description: The run summary's own numbers, as stored (mean net R and its t are never recomputed).
StoredTradeSummary.title: StoredTradeSummary

Tails.description: RK2: overlapping 21-session sums and their 1% and 5% mean shortfall.
Tails.title: Tails

TrackRecord.description:
SV2: null sessions and years when the threshold is not reachable (Sharpe at or below it) or the moments
leave it undefined; `reason` says which.
TrackRecord.title: TrackRecord

TradeStats.description: TA1 over per-trade net P&L (USD, after commissions), with the definitions of the Nautilus statistics.
TradeStats.title: TradeStats

TurnoverView.description: EX2: one-way turnover per session and its annualised mean (x 252).
TurnoverView.title: TurnoverView

ValidityView.description: SV1 and SV2 at SR* = 0 and at the benchmark Sharpe; SV4 from the registry; SV7 copied from the screen.
ValidityView.title: ValidityView
